items.item: Explains flow versions: saving creates a new version and only one version is active
items.evidence: Saving an active flow in Flow Builder creates a new, inactive version. Only one version is active at a time.

items.item: Tests the new version before activating (Flow test, debug run, or test records in the sandbox)
items.evidence: 3. Test the new version before activating. Run Flow tests... Debug it in rollback mode. Create or update a few real test Leads in `uat`.

items.item: Keeps the previous version available for rollback, and does not touch production
items.evidence: the old version stays for rollback... Don't delete old versions yet. Production is a separate step. A person moves the flow there with a change set
